text:
𝗗𝗔𝗬 𝟯 𝗜𝗡 𝗣𝗜𝗡𝗗𝗜! 🏏

Sri Lanka resume on 114/3, trailing Pakistan's 434/9d by 320.
They need 235 to avoid the follow-on; Kamindu is on 40*.

Can they survive? 👇

#PAKvSL #Cricket
